_note: The crash test suite's targets (garage/crashSuite.js, npm run crash-test): the car driven into the test centre's wall at each speed from each direction (front first, reversing, side-on, a front corner at 30°), and into another car (rear-ending it, T-boning it, head on: both cars at half the speed). Per speed: every crash (every; and per direction or pair) — dents: some; mechanical: at most none / mild (each system no worse than mild) / heavy; loose: none, or the sockets that must be hanging loose; detached: none, or those that must be off; broken: at most that many windows and lights; minCondition: no part or the body below; heavy: heavy damage (something torn off, mechanical past mild, or a part under 50%); drivable: it can carry on (data/damage.json drivable). drivable { min, max }: the share of the crashes at that speed still drivable. cars.both: both cars; fair: two cars the same feel strengths within that share of each other; mass: a heavier car hit by this one at that speed feels less (the lighter feels ratio × more).

60._note: a loose bumper, maybe mild steering or radiator damage

100._note: heavy damage, the car usually still drivable
